item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will strengthen gradually later today to Wednesday, there will be a few showers over the region. The area of low pressure near Luzon will develop gradually, it will move westwards in the general direction of the vicinity of Hainan Island today and tomorrow. However, under the influence of the northeast monsoon, its movement remains uncertain. Winds will strengthen slightly over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Another surge of northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week, temperatures will fall slightly over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move inland over eastern China and weaken gradually today.
